visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands wearing a simple gold ring and a thin bracelet, delicately opening the top of a white canvas tote bag. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with white cabinetry and a reflective refrigerator surface in the background. (2) The person carefully lifts a brown cardboard box out of the tote bag and places it on a wooden surface. A small silver metallic label is visible on the top of the box as the hands adjust its position. (3) The box is opened to reveal layers of transparent bubble wrap. The person's hand reaches in to retrieve a folded piece of paper, which appears to be a handwritten letter with blue ink on a cream-colored background. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the handwritten letter being held open, showing dense Traditional Chinese characters. The camera then cuts to a medium shot of a woman's face, her eyes looking down at the letter with a gentle expression, partially obscured by a pink bunny emoji. (5) The person begins unwrapping a large object from the bubble wrap, creating significant movement. The scene transitions to a close-up of the woman's hands cradling a large, rough-textured crystal geode with pale blue interior crystals (celestite). (6) The final phase shows the blue crystal geode placed on a light wood shelf. It is positioned among other decorative items including a white Diptyque candle, a small golden globe, and various red and gold charms, under soft, warm indoor lighting.
